name: Amazon DynamoDB
line: Managed key-value and document database with item APIs and indexes.

free.text: 25 GB, 25 RCUs/WCUs per Region; free account closes at 6 months

sql.math: 100,000 reads plus 20,000 writes come to $0.025. This assumes each operation reads or writes one item at a time, and that storage and transfer stay within the remaining free allowances.
Fits within the unused free allowances: 25 read units (RCU), 25 write units (WCU) and a 25 GB storage allowance that renews each month. Whether the app's workload fits these limits is not confirmed.

files.math: DynamoDB stores data items, not files, so it is not a file store.

jobs.math: 10,000 coordination writes at $0.625 per million. The workers that run the jobs are billed separately and not included.
